name: OnDocumentPost
caption: When a document is posted (interactive)

configuration.description: Document table: Sales Header 36 or Purchase Header 38. Extensions can register more postable tables. Known supported values: 36, 38. Extensions can register more, so other values are not rejected by this reference.
Run only in interactive client sessions; postings from background or service sessions are left untouched.

Seconds the flow may run. Checked between steps: once it has passed, the remaining steps are skipped and the posting goes ahead without the flow's answer. 0 or a negative value means no limit; the editor writes 30 instead.

Field filters on the document header: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Applied literally with SetFilter (max 250 characters, no placeholders). A filter that Business Central cannot parse means the flow does not run. Two rows for the same field: the last one wins.

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; tableNo = configuration.tableNo (declared as 'value' when tableNo is 0)

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be > 0. Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Pick the document table the flow should watch.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be a supported postable document table (Sales Header 36, Purchase Header 38, or one registered by an extension). Hard stop at publish.
rules.message: Table %1 is not one of the supported postable document tables.

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while no table is picked.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: Live status line in the configuration dialog (does not block saving): shown when the table does not exist or is not supported.
rules.message: Table %1 does not exist in this environment. | Table %1 is not supported by this trigger, so the flow would never run.

rules.check: guiOnly should be a JSON boolean.
rules.message: (no message; a value that is not a boolean is ignored and the default true applies)

rules.check: Any error in the flow (e.g. an Error step) prevents the posting and shows the flow's message.
The flow runs inline, so a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails and the posting is prevented.
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

notes: Fires at the start of Sales/Purchase posting, before any posting work. Posting previews never fire it. With guiOnly (default), non-UI sessions (e.g. batch posting in the Job Queue) are skipped.

Synchronous and atomic: runs inline in the user's transaction, without commits. An error prevents the posting. A Set document field values step writes values onto the header before it is posted. 'Skip standard processing' has no effect for this trigger (posting cannot be taken over).
timeoutSec is checked between steps. When it has passed, the remaining steps are skipped and the posting continues without a Set document field values answer.
Because it runs outside a table event, a Confirm dialog step can ask the user; the posting waits for the answer.
Re-entrancy guard: a posting that the running flow itself performs does not start the flow again.
No recurring Job Queue entry; the registration is keyed by tableNo.
Picker filter: Set document field values is offered. Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name and Prevent page close are hidden.
